Description: The process or processes performed on the parent specimen to produce this specimen. List more than one when they were done together in a single step (e.g. genetic modification, cell cloning when an edited clone is isolated). A modification made at a later time point is a new row whose parentSpecimenID is the previous step. Expected when parentSpecimenID is provided.
Valid Values: reprogramming, genetic modification, immortalization, cell cloning, differentiation

Description: A process where fully differentiated or specialized cells revert to pluripotency or a less differentiated cell type.
The introduction, alteration or integration of genetic material into a cell or organism.

The cellular developmental process in which a relatively unspecialized cell, e.g. embryonic or regenerative cell, acquires specialized structural and/or functional features that characterize a specific cell. Differentiation includes the processes involved in commitment of a cell to a specific fate and its subsequent development to the mature state.
